TXL Screener

TXL Screener helps investors track high-priority stocks, monitor market momentum, and make more informed timing decisions.

What it offers
- Hand-curated watchlists focused on important equities
- Heatmap and detailed views for quick market scanning
- Real-time-style technical signal tracking (including RSI, MACD, and EMAs)
- AI chat to ask questions about watchlists and recent market context
- Thesis posts with human-written bull and bear viewpoints

Where the data comes from
- Stock prices, technical indicators, and related market news are provided by Alpaca Markets.
- Watchlists and thesis posts are curated and stored in Notion, then surfaced in the app.
- AI chat answers are generated with Google Gemini, using your questions plus recent context such as news when available.

How to use it
- Spot oversold/overbought conditions for potential entries and exits
- Compare momentum across sectors and symbols
- Review supporting context before making portfolio moves
- Use smaller, staged entries rather than all-at-once decisions

Important notes
- Data from Alpaca can be delayed; always confirm with your broker or primary data source.
- This product is for research and education only, not financial advice.

Live app
https://screener.txl.app
